# openwrt_network_interface (Data Source)

Runtime status of a logical interface (netifd).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Logical interface, e.g. `wan`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean)
- `device` (String)
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS servers.
- `ipv4_addresses` (List of String) IPv4 addresses in CIDR notation.
- `ipv6_addresses` (List of String) IPv6 addresses in CIDR notation.
- `ipv6_prefixes` (List of String) Delegated IPv6 prefixes in CIDR notation.
- `l3_device` (String)
- `pending` (Boolean)
- `proto` (String)
- `up` (Boolean)
- `uptime` (Number) Seconds since the interface came up.
